card.title: Keeper of Precedent
card.instruction: Treat your longer memory as an archive, not a throne. Cite specific promises and precedents whenever the relationship faces a new choice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you take the car, our note says we call each other first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were asleep. Mum needed collecting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We allowed that when your dad missed the last bus. Same exception?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, but please stop saving these on takeaway menus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fair. Let's copy the exception into our phones before the curry price changes again.
